seats.text:
Fixed `dates.ts`: the loop condition `t < e` excluded the end date, so ranges were missing their last day. Changed to `t <= e`. Existing validation (regex format check + `Date.parse`/`toISOString` round-trip + `s > e` check) already correctly rejects malformed strings, impossible calendar dates, and start-after-end. Verified with test cases covering inclusive ranges, single-day ranges, leap-day validity, and all error paths.

The chatroom (rq1) converged on the same fix, and the proposal was unanimously accepted after I challenged an unmatched verification entry and it was resolved with a correctly-tagged one.
